notion_page_update: Implemented v0.9 Modified Phase 6 Study Framework + Synthesis Workbench on branch feature/v0.9-field-sensemaking. Designed an integrated, comparative analytical workspace that anchors field evidence to Study Questions (RQ-***) across five comparative lenses (Site, Stakeholder, Method, Theme, Matrix). Evaluators can capture lightweight Working Patterns (PAT-***) with one-click promotion to draft findings, author findings backed by live Support Profiles (computeSupportProfile) with triangulation diagnostics, enforce mandatory limitation notes for Emerging claims, anchor downstream Recommendations (REC-***) directly in validated findings, and enforce pure dependency invalidation when validated findings undergo substantive edits (amber warning banner in UI and exclusion from formal export until re-validated). Pristine demo templates remain read-only. Added 19 new Vitest unit/integration tests (122 total tests passing across 12 files), comprehensive technical guide in docs/v0.9_synthesis_workbench_guide.md, and 18-step automated CDP browser acceptance audit with 14 screenshots. ESLint and Next.js production build pass cleanly.
